main_text.p: cletus, Consolator, Advocatus, procurator. Plur. פַּרְקְלִיטִין.
פַּרְקְמַטְיָא Ch. Mercatura, negotiatio, Graec. πραγματεία. Vide quoque supra in פרג.
פָּרַךְ Ithpahel אִתְפָּרַּר Frangi, conteri, cominui, dissipari, Psal. 22.15.
פְּרִירִיָא, פְּרִירִין Ch. Lapilli minuti, Scrupi, Idem quod supra פְּרִידִין.

פָּרַשׁ Ch. & Syr. Separare, segregare, disparare, distinguere, distinctionem facere, discernere, disjungere: & intransitivè, Separare se, discedere, abscedere, Act. 13. 13. Lucae 9.33. 1. ad Corinth. 7. 15. Deinde Ch. Exponere, explicare, explanare, declarare, Exprimere nominatim, expresse vocare vel nominare: Item Mirum, admirabile esse vel fieri, In admirationem rapi, Psal. 139.14. Pahel פֻּרַשׁ Idem: Ite, Mirabile, mirificum reddere vel efficere. Aphel אַפְרַשׁ Idem. Ithpehal אִתְפָּרַשׁ Separari, segregari, disjungere, separare se: Explanari, explicari, declarari, expresse nominari, vocari, definiri.

פָּרִישׁ, פְּרִישׁ Chal. & Syr. Separatus, segregatus: Distinctus, פָּרִישׁ Indistinctus, 1. ad Corint. 14.8. Item Mirandum, admirandū, miraculum, mirabile, Peculiare aliquid: Fœmin. פְּרִישָׁתָּה Miraculosum opus suum, Jesa. 5.19. Plural. fœmin. פְּרִישִׁין & פְּרִישָׁתָא Miracula, mirabilia.
פְּרִישָׁתָא Ch. Extensiones, expansiones, Jobi 36.29. Praestaret autem scribi per ש, ut respondeat Hebraeo מְפָרְשִׁי. פִּירוּשׁ
